description: Player path dry run (lab play olife --dry-run = everything of `lab play olife` except the stock engine): the play_stack sidecar brings up the supervised stack via olife.play_up (world on a COPY of D:\Prog\Olife\play\worlds, real olife-sandboxd, auth tickets, Rust gateway, account user + admin, sample benches demo_orbit/demo_follow/demo_blink, client packs synced into the 0.32 content as junctions); the F2F 0.32 test build runs the SAME content/olife_client/scripts/app/olife.lua with the same export\olife_server.txt: connect by ticket, sample benches move, Injector -> editor (F2F gui) -> type code -> Run, GravityGun grab/turn/release, status lines; on stop olife.play_down (session summary) and the play report (labcore.play) from the client and sidecar logs. UX round 1 (olife_ux1): olife_play_ux — editor in the original layout (code field the largest, no overlaps, scripts panel save/list/delete, Profiler and Settings pages, ` opens it), no coin in the inventory or item defs, tags only with the Injector, gravity gun one toggle per press under a button held 20 ticks (LMB and RMB), Shift+RMB opens the last entity not aimed at, Shift+LMB deletes it (world reply 0, sound, toast); F2F shots of the new pages into the run dir.
